concept: From Green Bean to First Pour: a visitor's flavor choice becomes a traceable roast, product and subscription outcome.
recommendations: Keep the bean transformation as the single Peak even though every section receives flagship craft.
Use heavy motion to explain roast, origin, brewing and recommendation changes rather than as ambient decoration.
Transform comparison into a one-bean-at-a-time tasting deck on mobile.

sections.title: Navigation and Hero
sections.role: Orient around same-day roasting and capture flavor intent.
sections.startState: Timestamp and green-bean frame establish the batch.
sections.endState: Bright, round or deep becomes the shared journey state.
sections.mechanismOwner: React flavor state plus GSAP opening sequence.
sections.connection: The selected profile propagates into proof, beans, brewing and subscription.
sections.desktop: Asymmetric type field with flavor instrument and cinematic frame sequence.
sections.mobile: Vertical flavor control with the media recropped beneath the decision.
sections.reducedMotion: Static first roast frame and immediate state swaps.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The visitor defines the cup they want and starts a tailored route.
sections.instruction: Flagship, heavily animated, rendered and modern-clean.

sections.title: Roastery Story and Proof
sections.role: Prove that freshness, scale and sourcing claims are operational facts.
sections.inputState: Shared flavor profile and neutral proof ledger.
sections.startState: The 1962 Probat and partner-farm figures enter as separate facts.
sections.endState: Roaster, farm contracts and shipment timestamp resolve into one batch record.
sections.connection: Turns the hero promise into evidence before product selection.
sections.desktop: Pinned mechanical ledger with synchronized figures and batch path.
sections.mobile: Short vertical proof chapters with no lateral travel.
sections.reducedMotion: Complete ledger shown at once with grouped headings.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors understand why Northwind's freshness claim is credible.
sections.instruction: High craft and motion with deliberate visual rest.

sections.title: Bean Collection
sections.role: Compare six coffees and convert taste preference into a product decision.
sections.inputState: Flavor profile selected; six stable bean identities available.
sections.startState: Green beans and equal product identities occupy a stable comparison field.
sections.endState: Eight roast frames resolve into one emphasized recommendation without hiding alternatives.
sections.mechanismOwner: GSAP frame-sequence scrub plus React selection state.
sections.connection: The choice made here changes the brew guide and subscription recommendation.
sections.desktop: Pinned roast sequence beside a stable six-bean comparison rail.
sections.mobile: One focused bean stage with swipe/tap navigation and compact alternatives.
sections.reducedMotion: Three semantic roast stills and direct selection controls.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The visitor selects a coffee with a clear relationship between roast development and flavor.

sections.title: Brew Guide
sections.role: Translate the chosen bean into an understandable four-step pour-over ritual.
sections.inputState: Selected bean and its roast level.
sections.startState: Four tools and instructions are staged as separate brewing variables.
sections.endState: Weight, grind, bloom and pour resolve into one timed recipe.
sections.mechanismOwner: Scroll-driven SVG brew path with synchronized type and timer states.
sections.connection: Shows the practical consequence of the bean choice.
sections.desktop: Horizontal process instrument with an advancing water path.
sections.mobile: Vertical timed recipe with each step occupying a clear viewport chapter.
sections.reducedMotion: Complete numbered recipe and static path.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors know how to brew the selected coffee successfully.
sections.instruction: Rendered, instructional motion without fantasy effects.

sections.title: Subscriber Reviews
sections.role: Provide human evidence for freshness, discovery and gifting.
sections.inputState: Three testimonials represented as raw subscriber notes.
sections.startState: Names, dates and quotes enter as separate field-note fragments.
sections.endState: Fragments align into a clean annotated subscriber record.
sections.connection: Human proof bridges brewing confidence to the subscription decision.
sections.desktop: Overscale quote choreography with stable attribution anchors.
sections.mobile: One quote per chapter with progress marks and no auto-carousel.
sections.reducedMotion: All quotes presented as a readable static stack.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors see distinct, credible reasons people stay subscribed.
sections.instruction: Flagship typography while remaining a rhythmic rest.

sections.title: Subscription
sections.role: Resolve prior choices into a tailored recurring order.
sections.inputState: Selected profile, bean and adapted brew settings.
sections.startState: The generic two-bag subscription is shown as an open batch record.
sections.endState: A named bean pairing and monthly recommendation are ready to start.
sections.mechanismOwner: React shared-state consequence with GSAP bag assembly.
sections.connection: Pays off the choice made before the Peak with a concrete downstream decision.
sections.desktop: Two physical bag planes assemble around the live recommendation.
sections.mobile: Single recommendation card with a compact alternative selector.
sections.reducedMotion: Completed recommendation and controls shown immediately.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The visitor can act on a subscription matched to their stated taste.
sections.instruction: Major post-Peak consequence with clean physical rendering.

sections.title: Contact and Footer
sections.role: Close with a human exchange and preserve utility access.
sections.inputState: Open contact form and unresolved batch ledger.
sections.startState: Form, address and legal utilities sit in separate ledger columns.
sections.endState: Successful submission stamps the batch record and resolves the route.
sections.mechanismOwner: React form state plus restrained CSS/GSAP stamp transition.
sections.connection: Closes the same timestamped ledger introduced in the hero.
sections.desktop: Wide closing ledger with contact form and utility index.
sections.mobile: Form first, then utilities and a compact final batch stamp.
sections.reducedMotion: Instant success state with no stamp movement.
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors can contact the roastery and receive clear submission feedback.
sections.instruction: Flagship finish without obstructing the form or links.
